fire: Farmers add fertilizer rich in nitrogen to boost their corn yields.

The air we breathe is mostly nitrogen with some oxygen.

Each DNA strand carries a nitrogen base attached to a sugar.
Tires filled with nitrogen lose pressure more slowly.
Runoff carrying excess nitrogen feeds algae blooms in the bay.

Diesel engines release soot particles that irritate the lungs.
Dry ice keeps the samples frozen during shipping.
The air we breathe contains oxygen and a little argon.

Each DNA strand carries a phosphate group attached to a sugar.
